name: dcbot
description: Discord bot with moderation, utility, economy, music, ticketing, and auto-reconnect support.

scripts.stop: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const pid=fs.existsSync('.bot.pid')?fs.readFileSync('.bot.pid','utf8'):null; if(pid){ process.kill(Number(pid), 'SIGTERM'); console.log('Sent SIGTERM to bot PID', pid); process.exit(0);} else { console.log('No PID file found. Bot may not be running.'); process.exit(0);} "
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
